sequence.purpose: bounded catch-up read right after create; ends at the tail (x-eve-stream-tail-index header)

following read; stays open while a turn runs; closed by the client when followWhile returns false (idle), or by eve's 60 s lease ({"$eve":"stream.lease-ended"}) after which the client reconnects with startIndex

notes: Query keys seen: includeTailIndex, startIndex. Also valid per eve: follow=false (bounded read; the Worker's ticket transcript uses it).
A Worker should pass the query through unchanged and allow exactly: startIndex (integer, may be negative), includeTailIndex=1, follow=false.

recordedWith.client: eve/react useEveAgent (pinned 1.5.0) in a Next 16.3.6 static export

auth: Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` from `auth.bearer` (spike used `Bearer dev:<uid>`).
clientHeaders: Headers passed to `send(message, { headers })` are sent on that POST and then reused on the stream reads that follow it (eve: 'become the stream's credentials on its next reconnect'). The spike page sends `x-andronix-client-msg-id` (uuid per send) and `x-andronix-entry`; see docs/spike.md, contract note C1.
